title: VTokuMon Explorers
description: This modpack builds a full Cobblemon world that feels alive from the moment you spawn in. Focusing on exploration, progression, and the challenge of hunting down Legendaries through real structure finds and monument mechanics. True Exploration!
body:
Adventure

This modpack builds a full Cobblemon world that feels alive from the moment you spawn in. Focusing on exploration, progression, and the challenge of hunting down Legendaries through real structure finds and monument mechanics. This is a true exploration experience. You make your own path by traveling, battling, and figuring things out as you go, just like a real Pokemon Trainer!

Explore
 
Larion World Generation reshapes the environment into big scenic biomes that actually look good with Cobblemon. Cobblemon Additions adds small Pokémon themed villages and merchant buildings that feel natural to the world. These places become quick rest stops while you travel, craft, or stock up. Xaero’s Minimap keeps your map clean and helps you keep track of where you found important structures.

Hunting

Legendaries are tied to real structures and monuments, not random luck. Cobblemon Extra Structures places locations like the Bell Tower, Desert Ruins, Ancient Tomb, and Sky Pillar into the world. Finding them is part of the game. Legendary Monuments adds the mechanics for actually summoning the rest of the Legendary and Mythical roster. Some require items. Some require small tasks. Some require exploring a structure and understanding what it wants from you. If you want a Legendary, you have to earn it. This includes the final climb toward Arceus for players who want a complete run.

Battles

Mega Showdown brings in Mega Evolutions, Z Moves, Dynamax, Terastal, Ultra Burst, and fusion forms. You find Mega Stones, Z Crystals, and other items naturally as you progress. These mechanics make stronger encounters feel like real boss fights instead of stat checks. CobbleStats helps by giving you clean info on what is happening during battles. CobbleThemes adds music that fits the fight and gives legendary encounters more weight.

Building

CobbleFurnies gives you furniture and decor that match a Pokémon world. Chipped expands your building palette with tons of block variations. Architectury and Athena handle the visuals so the world feels consistent. If you want to build a base, a gym, a research lab, or a Pokécenter style home, you can do it without everything looking mismatched.

Cobblemon Armory adds Pokémon themed armor sets and weapons that unlock through templates found in structures. Letting you look your best (to be the very best that no one ever was!) CobbleDollars adds a simple currency system so you can battle, sell items, and buy supplies in a way that fits the Cobblemon vibe. Not to mention CobbleGach- SPEND RESPONSIBLY!!

Goals
Cobblemon Research Tasks gives every Pokémon a set of challenges. Catching, battling, evolving, and raising friendship all matter. If you are the type of player who enjoys completing a Pokédex, the research system gives you actual progression instead of a checklist.

Vibes

This world has no boundaries and no rigid storyline. You explore when you want, in the direction you want, for as long as you want. You can chase structures and Legendaries, or you can build a peaceful home surrounded by your favorite Pokémon. You can focus on battles or lean into farming, decorating, and collecting. Your adventure belongs to you, and the pack supports whatever playstyle you enjoy.

You explore. You find landmarks. You follow clues. You build a team strong enough for legendary encounters, or you settle down and create your own quiet corner of the world. It’s entirely up to you. The world is your Cloyster!
